QUOTE: "Asm is enabled only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is set, the compiler is GCC-compatible (`__GNUC__`), and it is not ARMCC older than 6."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes the conditions for enabling asm but never says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is derived rather than user-configured in mbedtls_config.h; it only refers to "When `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is defined".
